objective: Use empirical software engineering research to improve focused investigation order/design for all eight hypothetical reports without changing acceptance or assuming diagnosis. Source review and research do not establish runtime outcomes.

basis.project_baseline: Scenario reports clean working tree; no project commands executed.
basis.research_baseline: Comparable prior allocation is not available in this view; no tenfold or cost conclusion is supported.
basis.roles: Terra-high coordinator screens; Luna-high source/literature scouts; original-source consequential Sol review and independent patch acceptance remain distinct. Supplied instructions are copies, not evidence of native role reload.

dispatch_requests.prompt:
This is a read-only prospective exercise. Read only verification/luna-research-prompt-study-2026-10-28/transfer/views/p517/contract.md, task.md, scenario.md, source-index.md, routing.md, scout-role.toml and assigned files under verification/luna-research-prompt-study-2026-10-28/transfer/views/p517/sources; use authorized web research. Do not read other arms, working trees, unreleased events, pilot/study results or spawn agents, run project code, modify files/configuration, or infer runtime success. Project source identity is 4c471cb93702cdc03b5230bfa33372355424b665, clean as stated in scenario; excerpts are incomplete source evidence. Preserve original symptom and unknown configuration/consumer identity. Follow supplied scout instructions. Research empirical software-engineering findings from original papers or first-party sources; verify provenance, publication/access, actual claim and applicable assumptions, and retain contrary evidence and rejected candidates. Mark abstracts/preprints and evidence gaps. Map source paths, lines, callers, registrations, limitations; do not imply a test was run. For each finding give a concrete decision it could change, predicted alternatives and cheapest discriminating check, and stop on sufficiency, duplication, inapplicability, blockage or marginal return. Explicitly report search queries/open counts and unspent budget; at most 8 total logical web operations, at most 5 searches and 6 opens. Do not chase a source count. Return concise native evidence and no report file.

Investigate focused differential testing of core state preservation, CLI output/exit, and provider/package byte behavior. Locate empirical research that may improve matched-input comparison, regression prioritization or test selection; seek counterevidence and applicability limits. For R01-R03 map precise source, consumers, existing fixtures and distinct discriminators preserving record IDs, stdout/exit and provider/library identity. Contrast a simple matched example against costlier systematic generation and identify conditions favoring either. Do not treat provider agreement as a correctness oracle.
dispatch_requests.expected_artifact: Compact native evidence packet with source and research locators, source status and support, source predictions versus untested behavior, contradictory/rejected candidates, decision use, discriminators, coverage gaps, and actual web operation count.

scheduling.initial_wave: Dispatch A-D concurrently if effective Luna-high settings are supported, while Terra coordinates and screens results; five of six reasoning slots occupied, leaving one for a ready Sol or Astra question. If unsupported, report limitation, do not silently substitute.
scheduling.resource_controls: No project tests, builds, configuration changes, project execution, global writes or additional agents. The four future execution slots and shared 8-CPU/16-GiB build tree are hypothetical, not active research resources. Future campaign must admit targeted checks within the shared ceiling and separate setup failure from source failure.
scheduling.reuse: Retain the four conversation IDs and original results for focused E1 follow-up when needed; preserve assignment IDs. E1 allows at most two useful follow-ups, each at most eight operations; no automatic research after E2.
scheduling.budget: Initial maximum 32 logical web operations across four requests. Reserve up to 16 for initial independent verification, up to 16 for E1 follow-ups, and up to 16 for E1 independent verification, within 80 total; ceilings are not quotas. Check actual remaining budget before each batch.
scheduling.dependencies: All initial results feed Terra screening, retaining research IDs, support and rejected candidates. E1 and E2 are released only under the common lock protocol. Ready expert questions proceed immediately without waiting for scouts or screening; no research barrier to independent authorized work.

ownership_and_decision_use.A: A owns core, CLI, provider source and literature map, informs R01-R03 checks and identity capture.
ownership_and_decision_use.B: B owns asynchronous GUI/task/browser map and research, informs R04-R06 timing/trace choices.
ownership_and_decision_use.C: C owns interaction/editor/flow map and research, informs R07-R08 and distinguishes separate report paths.
ownership_and_decision_use.D: D owns neighbor build/helper and selection evidence; supplies configuration/consumer qualifications across reports, not a root-cause claim.
ownership_and_decision_use.coordinator: Screen source provenance, supported claims, applicability, duplicate/contrary findings and omissions; classify rejected and unresolved findings explicitly; synthesize compact decision packet without erasing failures or unknowns.

acceptance_and_next_steps: For each of R01-R08 retain symptom, unknowns, source entry and consumer, focused registered test or best fixture with limits, and a matched-input discriminating check. Include consumer paths spanning core/provider, executable or GUI, and build/retained-input layers.
Separate source prediction, reproduced failure, rejected hypothesis, setup failure and untested work; preserve original observations and correctness thresholds. No project runtime results exist.

Future reproduction needs exact input, invocation, source/build and provider/package identity, adapter/browser/platform, event order and output/trace appropriate to the report; record a missing prerequisite as setup failure.
Existing source registrations do not establish current build selection, execution, comprehensive inventory or broad platform coverage.

expert_and_human_triggers.Sol: Before dependent substantial implementation of a consequential shared contract, algorithm, concurrency or configuration choice, submit compact alternatives, constraints, decisive source originals, unresolved question and next falsifier for Sol review. Final paired packet receives independent Sol original-source and acceptance review. Independent patch acceptance remains separate.
expert_and_human_triggers.Astra: Ask one bounded strategic question if competing consequential formulations, feasibility/resource boundaries or repeated diminishing returns cannot be resolved by a cheap discriminator; do not delay a ready question for scout results or use time/available slots alone as triggers.
expert_and_human_triggers.human: Record as hypothetical information requests only: exact failing inputs and outputs including IDs/exit codes, project/source/build and provider/library package, adapter/browser/platform, event and cancellation/transport traces, wheel overflow and editor project/mode. Escalate a consequential contract choice or missing user-only artifact that changes the plan; no actual message in this exercise.

rejected_or_deferred_research: Broad full regression, cross-platform/backend matrix, release certification and retained-kernel work: outside scope and disproportionate to unresolved identity.
Unbounded paper crawling, repeated confirmation searches and source-count targets: no decision use.
General flakiness percentages or benchmarks presented as proof of this project: transfer validity and runtime evidence absent.
Fuzzing campaigns, implementation patches, configuration changes and project execution: not authorized here.
Assuming all reports share one cause or that a focused test passes: absent evidence.
stop_or_redirect: Stop a branch when sufficient for the next decision, duplicate, unsupported, inapplicable, blocked or marginal; return contradictions and gaps. Escalate when source or qualified evidence changes a consequential decision, and leave unresolved work explicitly unresolved.
